description: Fixtures for the xebench benchmarks contract 1.4 (data/benchmarks.schema.json, docs/WEBSITE-HANDOFF.md): ExecuTorch in build. Next to build.runtimes, a row may name the runtimes ExecuTorch and react-native-executorch, with engineVersion "ExecuTorch <version>" and bindingVersion "react-native-executorch <version>". Each file is a complete envelope. producerMustNotEmit=true marks a file that breaks a producer rule: scripts/validate_data.mjs refuses it. consumerExpectation is what the website does with it. tests/test_contract_1_4.py checks producerMustNotEmit against scripts/validate_data.mjs.
